nvitk.db.xnat_pipeline_resources
================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.db.xnat_pipeline_resources

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Sync qvtpy / eICAB XNAT experiment resources into the dataset ``assets`` table.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: inspect_xnat_pipeline_resource(experiment: Any, resource_label: str) -> dict[str, Any]

   Return availability metadata for one experiment resource (no download).


.. py:function:: unwrap_xnat_resource_download(dest_dir: pathlib.Path, resource_label: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Promote ``{experiment}/resources/{label}/files/*`` up to *dest_dir*.

   xnatpy ``download_dir`` extracts the REST ZIP with experiment/resource nesting.
   Local QC / pipeline loaders expect the uploaded payload (stage folders, NIfTIs)
   directly under the destination, matching the on-disk results layout.


.. py:function:: download_experiment_resource(experiment: Any, resource_label: str, dest_dir: pathlib.Path, *, overwrite: bool = False) -> pathlib.Path

   Download an experiment-level XNAT resource into *dest_dir*.

   After download, unwraps xnatpy's ``{experiment}/resources/{label}/files`` nesting
   so *dest_dir* matches the local pipeline results layout.


.. py:function:: sync_xnat_pipeline_resources(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig, *, catalog_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, subjects: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, subjects_file: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, id_type: str = 'subject', resources: Iterable[str] = QVTPY_PIPELINE_RESOURCES, download_root: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, download_resources: bool = False, overwrite_downloads: bool = False, skip_existing_downloads: bool = True, build_sqlite_index: bool = False, source_batch_id: str | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Index qvtpy/eICAB experiment resources on XNAT into ``assets``.


.. py:function:: list_pipeline_assets_for_subject(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, project_id: str, subject_uid: str) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Return indexed pipeline bundle rows for *subject_uid*.

   Includes ``eicab`` / ``qvtpy`` / ``4dflows`` experiment resources. Derived
   ``4dflows`` file rows (``source=xnat_4dflows``) are collapsed to a single
   downloadable ``pipeline_4dflows`` bundle entry when no bundle row exists.
